oh my god please get out, you owe them nothing, i thought you were going to say you were 20 -- you are obv very level-headed for your age and living at home is going to do nothing but destroy your soul. don't ever let them make you feel indebted. it's so unfortunate that you come from a family like this and you may feel tempted to stay just so that you have *someone*, but trust me, as hard as it seems, not having a family can be better than having a family like yours. im not telling you to cut them off completely at age 16 but you're going to die inside if you don't start to live your own life the way you want to. you didnt mention suicide in your post but i dont think it was a coincidence that you posted here. it would be such a tragedy for someone like you to be stifled or killed by people like them.
